title: Non-anchor 7-by-14 grid-layout column-edge prediction
rationale: This lane predeclares the orthogonal column-edge target from the same source-context 7-by-14 padded layout rule before any future source-backed observation is scored. The source is archive-context-only, so it can justify the structural rule but cannot supply scored positions. This lane exists so column-edge scoring is explicit and preregistered rather than inferred from the earlier row-edge lane or from the prior diagnostic column run.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched at predeclared 7-by-14 column-edge positions if vertical edge structure is relevant to the padded rectangular layout.
discovery_inputs: Known-clue occupied positions for exclusion only
Context-only KryptosBot/Sanborn-papers rationale that 97 plus one padding character is compatible with a 7-by-14 rectangular layout
Predeclared column-edge rule emitted before observing or scoring future source-backed positions
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations
Observation files that declare eligible source IDs, one-based positions, per-position notes, and rationale before evaluation
Source-backed position sets not used to construct the 7-by-14 grid-layout artifact
controls: seeded null over sampled non-anchor position sets of the same size
validate-grid-observations and evaluate-grid-prediction required before interpreting source-backed observations
the evaluator must use --edge-axis column and this preregistration before a source-backed archive can be treated as evidence
multiple-comparison correction if interpreted beside period, spacing, mirror, row-edge grid, or Tableau/HILL families
archive-context-only sources cannot directly provide scored observation positions
